noun_definition: export onyx state refers to an option that is proposed to be added to the Troubleshoot menu and activated by a four-finger tap for exporting the current state of the Onyx application.
troubleshoot menu refers to a section in the application where users can access options related to diagnosing and resolving issues.
four finger tap refers to a gesture that is likely intended to trigger an action in the Troubleshoot menu, as suggested by its mention alongside the "Export Onyx state" option.
